_comment: Template: LTP on a physical device. Copy to configs/local_<name>.json and replace every <PLACEHOLDER>; only *.template.json is tracked by git.
_comment_build_id: build_id may be 'latest' or a numeric id. Pin ids in your local copy when you need a reproducible run.
_comment_serial: serial_port is left empty on purpose. Fill it in your local copy or pass -s <serial>; a physical job with neither fails.
_comment_builds: pb = platform build, kb = GKI kernel build, vkb = vendor kernel build, sb = system build. Use kb or vkb, whichever matches your device.

global_config._comment_timeouts: Optional. GNU timeout duration strings. See README.md.
